title: The TypeScript run-state store accepts the classification decision record
description: Triaged 2026-09-23 from wne's close-out. The Go reconciler writes a classify-tick decision record the TypeScript run-state store throws on (7ef948eb), so any record the Worker reads back from a run that classified breaks it.
acceptance_criteria: The TS run-state store parses a classify-tick decision record as the Go side writes it, proven by a shared fixture both sides test against; and the full suites pass
